=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text x " x "
text eqs " = "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note prime factors in ascending order by trial division; 1 is shown as itself
note bound: each pass divides v or steps d, and d * d <= v; for the inputs here d never passes 6857
fn tell n ulong to void
emitu n
emit eqs
if eq n 1
emitu 1
emit nl
ret
end
v = n
d = ulong 2
f = ulong 0
while le mul d d v bound 999999
if eq rem v d 0
if gt f 0
emit x
end
emitu d
f = add f 1
v = div v d
else
d = add d 1
end
end
if gt v 1
if gt f 0
emit x
end
emitu v
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
for i ulong 25
tell add i 1
end
for i ulong 13
tell add 2144 i
end
tell 600851475143
tell 1000000000000
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
